title: 外部連結ロッドと駆動部付きの多翼ダクトダンパー
titleEn: Multiblade duct damper with external linkage and actuator
description: 矩形換気ダクトの途中に組み込む流量調整ダンパーの静的プロップ。両端が開いた短いケーシングと接続フランジ、部分開度で固定した4枚の厚い羽根、各羽根の貫通軸と軸受、外側クランクと共通連結ロッド、琥珀色の外部アクチュエーターを造形しています。静止ルーバーとは異なり連動羽根機構の外形を持ちますが、可動リグ、角度制御、気密遮断、空気流量、電気制御、防火・防煙性能や認証は付属しません。接続ダクトと吊り架台は別途配置してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.296 × 1.105 × 0.486 m、8,388三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static airflow-control damper prop for installation within a rectangular ventilation duct, with an open-ended short casing and connecting flanges, four thick blades fixed partially open, through-shafts and bearings, exterior cranks and a common tie linkage, and an amber-covered external actuator. The linked-blade mechanism is structurally distinct from a static wall louver, but no movable rig, angle control, airtight shutoff, airflow, electrical control, fire/smoke performance or certification is supplied. Connecting ducts and suspension supports must be placed separately. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.296 × 1.105 × 0.486 m; 8,388 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
